thread:
jordan: Quick follow-up from the KV-eviction postmortem. We need owners and short timelines for regression + load + chaos so this doesn't keep popping up.

lia: I'll own the regression promptset. Plan: ~35 prompts covering cache-hit, long-context KV usage, and batch embeddings. Will add to regress/kv-evict-2026 and wire an eval job `evals/kv-evict-check`. Target 2026-04-06.

peter: I'll do the load profile and a staging CI job. Using k6 with Zipfian hot-key skew. Local dev command: `k6 run scripts/kv-burst.js --vus 250 --duration 8m --out json=artifacts/kv-burst.json`. Due 2026-04-06.

ana: (typo) ana: I'll take the chaos drill runbook and pilot scheduling. Pilot in staging on 2026-04-08 19:00 UTC. Runbook will include exact metrics and rollback thresholds.

jordan: For gating, ops wants a post-deploy eval: run `evals/kv-evict-check` for 10m and block if fallback_rate > 1%. Can someone add dashboard tiles for `model_fallback.count` and `kv_eviction.rate` with model tags?

lia: Will include fallback_rate and latency_p95 in the eval config. Sample JSON I'll put in the PR.

peter: I'll open PRs: load script + CI job -> https://git.internal/redwood/load-scripts/pull/112.

ana: Runbook PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/227

ops-bot: Note: staging maintenance window reserved 2026-04-08 19:00-20:00 UTC. Add who: @ana @peter @eng-oncall.

jordan: Acceptance criteria: (1) regress eval in CI, (2) reproducible k6 profile and staging run, (3) chaos pilot executed, (4) gating prevents fallback >1%, (5) dashboards + alerts added. I'll move these into the postmortem board once PRs merge. Drop PR links here when ready.

lia: :white_check_mark: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rls-evals/pull/497

peter: :white_check_mark: load PR linked above.

ana: :white_check_mark: runbook linked.

jordan: Thanks all. We'll recheck in next week's postmortem sweep. Closing thread after PR merges and pilot run. :rocket:
